listing.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A (PokeZ-ARecomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C/x64 static runtime NVN/Vulkan, LAS-derived; no runtime emulator claimed. Upstream maturity: Only Windows/NVIDIA observed; partial Lumiose exploration/battles, no full completion established; black flashes/night wall stripes. Save version conversion caveat. Acquisition: Actual Windows ZIP launcher contains game-free runtime/generator/importer/compiler by root claim; own package locally imported/recompiled once. Platforms: Windows10v1903+/11 x64 Vulkan1.3, AVX2 preferred; SSE4.2 older CPU slower fallback. Linux/Mac inherited builds untested for Z-A. Original data: Own baseXCI/NSP1.0.0, optional2.0.0update and owned DLC, prod.keys/title.keys. Firmware fonts optional: Windows fallback font otherwise missing button icons.2.0.0 saves do not load on1.0.0; back up before conversion. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
